name: ONS Order Notifications for Slack
author: Awais Awan

sections.description:
Send WooCommerce Order Notifications Directly to Slack

Keep your team instantly updated with new WooCommerce orders by integrating your online store with Slack. This lightweight yet powerful plugin allows you to send real-time order notifications to any Slack channel of your choice, ensuring your sales and fulfillment teams are always in the loop.

With easy configuration options in the WordPress admin dashboard, you can fully customize the Slack messages to match your branding and workflow.

🔧 Key Features:

Real-Time Notifications
Automatically send WooCommerce order alerts to your Slack workspace as soon as a new order is placed.

Customizable Slack Integration
Set your Slack Incoming Webhook URL directly from the plugin settings page. No coding required.

Personalized Message Content
Configure the notification title, message color, and other basic styling options to reflect your brand tone or urgency level.

Easy-to-Use Admin Interface
A clean and user-friendly admin panel allows store owners and managers to quickly set up and manage notification settings without technical hassle.

Improve Workflow & Response Time
By receiving instant order alerts in Slack, your support, inventory, and fulfillment teams can take quicker action and enhance customer satisfaction.

This plugin is ideal for eCommerce store owners using WooCommerce who want better communication, faster order processing, and real-time sales tracking within their Slack workspace.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ons-order-notifications-for-slack directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Slack Notifications to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
How do I get a Slack webhook URL?

You can create a webhook URL in your Slack workspace by going to Apps > Incoming Webhooks.
